linkedin:
Managed MariaDB hosting means the platform provisions, patches, secures, and backs up a MariaDB database for you and hands over a connection string.

MariaDB is a community-governed fork of MySQL that stays highly compatible: same driver, same port 3306, same `mysqldump`. Pick MariaDB when your stack or Linux distro already expects it. For a brand-new app with no strong preference, MariaDB and MySQL are close to a coin-flip, so choose the one your team knows.
